reason: On night shifts I already get my caffeine from coffee or matcha, and if I want a mate I can grab a cheaper one on Rohlík. 55 CZK for one can doesn't give me anything I can't already get, and everyone says natural these days.
objection: It's another 'natural' mate at a premium price, and I don't see what makes it better than the cheaper mate I can already order.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it in the fridge at a café near my route after a long ride, priced closer to 40 CZK, so I could try it once without ordering a whole box online.
